ticket.summary: Meteor chance method still not perfect
ticket.description:
About the method of meteor chance that we're currently using \(which is better than the previous one, but still isn't perfect\):
<Kurper> Trafalgar: it seems like that only works right if config.meteorchance is a divisor of 100
<Kurper> because rand\(\) also only works with integers
<Kurper> it still works mostly right if meteorchance is not a divisor
<Kurper> but the probabilities would be off
<Kurper> if config.meteorchance is 75 then it would always spawn them
<Kurper> as an extreme example
<Trafalgar> The damn byond dm reference docs don't help
<Trafalgar> They don't say what inputs the functions accept or don't

The solution we came to, which will need to be implemented: Take the chosen chance, multiply times 100. Each tick, do rand\(10000\), compare the result to the pre-multiplied chance. This gives us have a chance with a precision of 0.01 percent points everywhere, which should be more than sufficient.
